risks.title: Volatility of aluminum and alumina prices
risks.score_rationale: Highlighted on the first pages of the 10-K as a central factor affecting results. Strong language: significant volatility. Direct impact on both main segments. Highly weighted Macro category.

risks.title: Dependence on high energy costs
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the context of production reduction at San Ciprián in 2022 and delayed restart. Language: mitigate the financial impact of high natural gas costs. Structural risk for European sites.

risks.title: Permanent closure of the Kwinana refinery
risks.score_rationale: Announced in 2025 with detailed justification (age, costs, bauxite challenges). Impact on 800,000 mtpy of inactive capacity. Demolition project through 2031 implies future costs.

risks.title: Industrial safety risks
risks.score_rationale: Positioned as a foundation of operational strategy. Strong language: essential foundation for reliable, high-quality operations. Absence of recent performance data but strategic priority affirmed.

risks.title: Dependence on regulatory approvals in Australia
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in strategy: advancing Australia mine approvals to unlock value. Indicates potential bottleneck on future projects. Strategic language but implicit risk of delay or denial.

risks.title: Risk of disruption in the San Ciprián restart
risks.score_rationale: Restart was already interrupted in April 2025 following a national power outage. Operation still ongoing (65% as of December 2025), therefore active exposure. Explicit mention of a critical external event.

risks.title: Exposure to geopolitical and energy risks in Europe
risks.score_rationale: The San Ciprián site in Spain is affected by gas prices and power outages. Tense European energy context. Risk amplified by reliance on a single region for strategic assets.

ai_positioning.summary: Alcoa Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing.
